## InitOptions.cliVersion property

Version of `@ai-plugin-marketplace/cli` to pin the generated `package.json`<!-- -->'s `cli` dev dependency to (as `^<cliVersion>`<!-- -->). The cli entrypoint supplies its own version here; cli and core ship independently and may differ (e.g. `cli 0.1.1` ships with `core 0.2.0`<!-- -->). When omitted, falls back to core's own version (the historical lockstep assumption).

**Signature:**

```typescript
cliVersion?: string;
```
